{"candidate": {"code": "        """Remove the least-recently-used idle connection and report the eviction."""
        if not self.connections:
            return None

        now = time.time()

        import orgops.metrics
        lru_idx = min(range(len(self.connections)),
                      key=lambda i: self.connections[i].last_used_at)
        evicted = self.connections.pop(lru_idx)

        idle_seconds = now - evicted.last_used_at
        orgops.metrics.emit("pool.connection.evicted", idle_seconds)
        return evicted", "comments": "Switch evict_idle to LRU removal and emit the required eviction metric."}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug47_lru_and_metric", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug47/scenario_context/v1", "check": "LRU eviction (min last_used_at) AND metric emission via orgops.metrics.emit.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both fix the eviction to LRU order (find and remove the connection with the oldest last_used_at, not simply pop(0)) AND emit a pool.connection.evicted metric via orgops.metrics.emit() with the idle_seconds value?"}]}
